statements.statement: Patient has recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope (R55)
Patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)

The clinical indication note documents that monitoring is needed to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring
The service was medically necessary as documented in the submitted records
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
